//: MAC-ONLY typecheck. Extends the app tsconfig and DROPS its `native/**` exclusion so the Expo native module's TypeScript (native/modules/*/src/**) is checked too. Run with `npm run typecheck:native` AFTER `npm run native:on && npm install` — it needs the optional native packages listed in native/package-additions.json to be present, so it WILL fail on a Windows checkout. That is expected and is not a regression: the shared quality gate is `npm run typecheck` (tsconfig.json), which never sees this tree.
